parameters.query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month, plan_tier, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count, SUM(amount) AS mrr, SUM(amount) * 12 AS arr, AVG(amount) AS arpu, SUM(amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS ltv FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 months' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at), plan_tier ORDER BY month DESC, plan_tier;

INSERT INTO revenue_dashboard_data (timestamp, mrr, arr, arpu, ltv, mrr_growth_rate, revenue_by_tier, forecast, total_customers) VALUES ('{{ $json.timestamp }}', {{ $json.mrr }}, {{ $json.arr }}, {{ $json.arpu }}, {{ $json.ltv }}, {{ $json.mrrGrowthRate }}, '{{ JSON.stringify($json.revenueByTier) }}'::jsonb, '{{ JSON.stringify($json.forecast) }}'::jsonb, {{ $json.totalCustomers }});

WITH current_mrr AS (SELECT plan_tier, SUM(amount) AS mrr FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY plan_tier), previous_mrr AS (SELECT plan_tier, SUM(amount) AS mrr FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active' AND created_at < DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) GROUP BY plan_tier), new_mrr AS (SELECT plan_tier, SUM(amount) AS mrr FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active' AND created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) GROUP BY plan_tier), churned_mrr AS (SELECT plan_tier, SUM(amount) AS mrr FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND cancelled_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) GROUP BY plan_tier) SELECT c.plan_tier, c.mrr AS current_mrr, COALESCE(p.mrr, 0) AS previous_mrr, COALESCE(n.mrr, 0) AS new_mrr, COALESCE(ch.mrr, 0) AS churned_mrr, COALESCE(p.mrr, 0) - COALESCE(ch.mrr, 0) AS retained_mrr FROM current_mrr c LEFT JOIN previous_mrr p ON c.plan_tier = p.plan_tier LEFT JOIN new_mrr n ON c.plan_tier = n.plan_tier LEFT JOIN churned_mrr ch ON c.plan_tier = ch.plan_tier ORDER BY c.plan_tier;

INSERT INTO mrr_dashboard_data (timestamp, total_mrr, total_new_mrr, total_expansion_mrr, total_contraction_mrr, total_churned_mrr, net_new_mrr, growth_rate, previous_total_mrr, mrr_by_plan, arr) VALUES ('{{ $json.timestamp }}', {{ $json.totalMRR }}, {{ $json.totalNewMRR }}, {{ $json.totalExpansionMRR }}, {{ $json.totalContractionMRR }}, {{ $json.totalChurnedMRR }}, {{ $json.netNewMRR }}, {{ $json.growthRate }}, {{ $json.previousTotalMRR }}, '{{ JSON.stringify($json.mrrByPlan) }}'::jsonb, {{ $json.arr }});

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS total_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT id) FILTER (WHERE status = 'active') AS active_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT id) FILTER (WHERE status = 'churned') AS churned_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT id) FILTER (WHERE status = 'active' AND plan = 'starter') AS starter_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT id) FILTER (WHERE status = 'active' AND plan = 'pro') AS pro_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT id) FILTER (WHERE status = 'active' AND plan = 'enterprise') AS enterprise_customers,
  AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(churned_at, NOW()) - created_at)) / 86400) AS avg_lifetime_days
FROM customers
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 months'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)
ORDER BY month DESC;

INSERT INTO customer_dashboard_data (timestamp, total_customers, active_customers, churned_customers, customer_growth_rate, churn_rate, retention_rate, plan_distribution, avg_lifetime_days)
VALUES ('{{ $json.timestamp }}', {{ $json.totalCustomers }}, {{ $json.activeCustomers }}, {{ $json.churnedCustomers }}, {{ $json.customerGrowthRate }}, {{ $json.churnRate }}, {{ $json.retentionRate }}, '{{ JSON.stringify($json.planDistribution) }}'::jsonb, {{ $json.avgLifetimeDays }});

WITH churned AS (
  SELECT id, email, plan, created_at, churned_at,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (churned_at - created_at)) / 86400 AS lifetime_days,
    CASE
      WHEN churned_at - created_at < INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 'early'
      WHEN churned_at - created_at < INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'long_term'
    END AS tenure_segment
  FROM customers WHERE status = 'churned' AND churned_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
),
active AS (
  SELECT id, plan, created_at,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - created_at)) / 86400 AS tenure_days
  FROM customers WHERE status = 'active'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM churned) AS churned_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM churned WHERE tenure_segment = 'early') AS early_churn,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM churned WHERE tenure_segment = 'medium') AS medium_churn,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM churned WHERE tenure_segment = 'long_term') AS long_term_churn,
  (SELECT AVG(lifetime_days) FROM churned) AS avg_lifetime_days,
  (SELECT plan, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM churned GROUP BY plan) AS churn_by_plan_json,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active WHERE tenure_days > 90) AS at_risk_candidates;

INSERT INTO churn_dashboard_data (timestamp, churned_count, early_churn, medium_churn, long_term_churn, avg_lifetime_days, at_risk_candidates, early_churn_rate, health_score)
VALUES ('{{ $json.timestamp }}', {{ $json.churnedCount }}, {{ $json.earlyChurn }}, {{ $json.mediumChurn }}, {{ $json.longTermChurn }}, {{ $json.avgLifetimeDays }}, {{ $json.atRiskCandidates }}, {{ $json.earlyChurnRate }}, {{ $json.healthScore }});

SELECT stage, COUNT(*) AS deal_count, SUM(value) AS total_value, AVG(value) AS avg_value,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS closed_7d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS created_7d
FROM deals
GROUP BY stage
ORDER BY
  CASE stage
    WHEN 'prospecting' THEN 1
    WHEN 'qualification' THEN 2
    WHEN 'proposal' THEN 3
    WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 4
    WHEN 'closed_won' THEN 5
    WHEN 'closed_lost' THEN 6
  END;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', demo_date) AS week,
  COUNT(*) AS total_demos,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed') AS completed_demos,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled_demos,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE demo_type = 'discovery') AS discovery_demos,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE demo_type = 'technical') AS technical_demos,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE demo_type = 'executive') AS executive_demos,
  AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS completion_rate
FROM demos
WHERE demo_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 weeks'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', demo_date)
ORDER BY week DESC;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', last_active_at) AS day,
  COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS active_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT id) FILTER (WHERE last_active_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') AS active_24h,
  COUNT(DISTINCT id) FILTER (WHERE last_active_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS active_7d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT id) FILTER (WHERE last_active_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') AS active_30d,
  AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_active_at)) / 86400) AS avg_days_since_active
FROM users
WHERE is_active = TRUE
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', last_active_at)
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 30;
